title: fix(plugin-approvals): an approval notification names the record by its title, as the recipient may read it
body:

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XMBYHj1ZHBx7grUypasmFts)_

Fixes #26181

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:审批通知(铃铛和邮件正文)不再用记录 id 指代记录,改用记录标题,而且按每个收件人各自能看到的字段来定:收件人能读标题字段就显示标题,读不到、被掩码或标题为空就退回 id。一条通知发给多人且各人看到的不一样时,按名称拆成几条发,谁也拿不到别人才能看的标题。
- **为什么改**:「您的合同 C8Mp7TjRYta8mOWx 已获批准」收件人看不出是哪份合同;维护者已按 A′ 重新裁决(#26181 裁决 6429362190)。
- **风险与回滚**:风险在字段级安全的收窄上,所有失败路径都退回 id,不会泄露标题;每个收件人多一次权限解析(只在装了安全插件且记录有标题时)。回滚就是回退这个 PR。邮件里一键审批的令牌页面不变,仍显示 id。
- **先看**:`approval-service.ts` 的 `notify()` 和 `subjectNamesFor()`;新测试 `notification-subject-title-per-recipient.integration.test.ts`;`action-link-pages.ts` 新加的说明。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/notification-subject-title-per-recipient.integration.test.ts`,预期 4 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`notify()` names the record per recipient.** A notice about a record now hands `notify()` the record (`about`) and a builder for its sentence (`text`), instead of a text built once. `notify()` asks `subjectNamesFor()` for the name each recipient reads, groups the recipients by name, and emits once per name, so a recipient never receives a text built around another recipient's title. A dedup key on a split notice is suffixed with each part's first recipient so messaging does not fold one part into another (no current call site sends a multi-recipient notice with a dedup key that reaches messaging; the reminder to slot literals is dropped before emit).
- **`subjectNamesFor()`** is the inbox's own title rule (`resolveSubjectDisplays`) asked as the recipient: the record is read once under the system context, and the title (ADR-0079 `nameField` via `resolveDisplayField`) is picked from it as served to the recipient, `titleAsServed()` over their `servedFields()` answer. The id stands when the record has no title, when the recipient may not read the title field or is served it masked, and when any read fails (at `warn`). `titleAsServed()` is extracted from `titlesAsServed()` so the inbox and the notifications share one spelling.
- **`recipientContext()`** builds the recipient's envelope the way the `@mention` recipient gate in `plugin-audit` does: `resolveUserAuthzGrants` in the request's organization, the organization kept while `vetOrganizationClaim` backs it under the posture in force. An email address is looked up to its account; one no account carries gets the id.
- **Cost.** One record read per notice; per recipient, one envelope resolution plus one field-visibility ask, and only when a field-visibility source is composed and the record has a title. With no security plugin the seam passes everything through, so no envelope is resolved. Most call sites notify one recipient; the slate-wide ones (SLA breach, escalation) pay per approver, the same resolution the administrators' slate already pays per member. Per-recipient is the rule itself (A′), so there is nothing to batch across recipients.
- **Unchanged:** the message templates keep `{{object}} {{record}}` (no title-plus-id suffix); the literal-body notices (comment, request for information, send-back note) name no record; the token-bearing action-link pages keep the id, with a dated note beside the #23594 comment in `action-link-pages.ts`.
- **Docs:** `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` said the outcome notification names the record as `Deal D_123`; it now says title as the recipient may read it, id as the fallback, id on the action pages.

## Tests

- New `notification-subject-title-per-recipient.integration.test.ts` (real `ApprovalService` on `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver`, a field-visibility double keyed by user): (a) a reader of the title field reads it in the literal body and the keyed `record` param, on `approval.requested` and `approval.approved`; (b) an empty title gives the id; (c) a recipient who may not read the title field, or is served it masked, gets the id and no trace of the title; (d) two recipients with different field-level security on one request get different bodies, both on per-approver emits (the opening) and on one emit naming both (the SLA breach, split into two emits).
- Red first on `main`: with `approval-service.ts` and `approval-notification-text.ts` checked out at the base `6390fe52`, (a) and (d) fail (`Received: "A decision on Contract C1 is waiting on you."`); (b) and (c) pass there, as the fallback controls they are.
- Ablation: `titleAsServed(record, displayField, readable)` mutated to ignore `readable` (via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, restored to the HEAD blob) turns (c) and (d) red.
- Updated, because they pinned ruling B's id in bodies whose fixtures carry a title: `approval-requested-notification` (the titled-record case now pins the live title, never the snapshot's), `approval-decision-outcome-notification`, `approval-notification-body` (the record name per call site), `approval-notification-keyed-text` (localized bodies and the end-to-end messaging render).

## Acceptance notes

- Two copies of "the envelope a named user reads with" now exist: `plugin-audit`'s `contextForMentionedUser` and approvals' `recipientContext`. Lifting one into `@objectstack/core` is outside this card's file surface. Noted, not filed.
- A cross-organization approver (ADR-0105 D9) with no membership in the request's organization never reaches a slate (`filterApproversWhoCanRead`), so the organization claim `recipientContext` vets holds for every approver that can be notified; one that does not hold resolves with no active organization and fails closed to the id.
